analysis: The method isDefaultPartition() first checks isAllPartitions(); if true, it returns false without calling get. Then it uses a short-circuit AND: if hasPartitionIds() returns false, the expression short-circuits and get is not called. If hasPartitionIds() is true, it checks getPartitionIds().size() == 1. Only if that is true does it proceed to call get(0). Since size() == 1, index 0 is within range (0 < size()), so the condition for IndexOutOfBoundsException (index < 0 || index >= size()) is never met. Thus, even though the API declares IndexOutOfBoundsException, it is fully avoided in this calling context.
answer: IndexOutOfBoundsException: The throwing condition is avoided because the call to get(0) only occurs when getPartitionIds().size() == 1, ensuring that index 0 is valid.
remark: No exceptions are thrown because the code’s precondition prevents the IndexOutOfBoundsException condition from occurring.
